docs.summary: Fluent builder for an Origami scroll view. Construct via [`ScrollView`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Origami~ScrollView); chain modifiers; call [`Body`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.ScrollViewBuilder~Body) to render.
docs.remarks:
Provides a clipped viewport that scrolls vertically (default) and/or horizontally. Wheel scrolls the vertical axis; `Shift+wheel` scrolls horizontal when enabled. Both scrollbar thumbs are draggable when their axis overflows.

Programmatic positioning: [`ScrollTo`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Origami~ScrollTo) registers a target offset keyed by ID; the next render of that scroll view applies it.

docs.summary: Spacing between stacked children. Forwarded to the content column's `Gap`.
Enable horizontal scrolling (default `false`). When on, content can extend beyond the viewport's width; the user scrolls via the bottom thumb or `Shift+wheel`.
Always show scrollbar tracks, even when content fits.
Scroll-wheel step in pixels per click (default 30).

When true (default) the content eases to the scroll offset (0.33s). Turn OFF for virtualized content: the visible window is computed from the target offset, so easing the content toward it would leave the rows mismatched (blank gaps) mid-animation. Virtualized lists snap instead.

When true (default) the scrollbars float over the content and reserve no layout space, so the content keeps its full width/height whether or not it overflows. Turn OFF to carve an inline gutter that the bar sits in (content shrinks to make room).
When true (default) the scrollbars are only shown while the pointer is over the scroll view (or a thumb is being dragged), easing in and out. Turn OFF to always show them.
Render the scroll view. `drawContents` draws inside the (scrollable) content area.
Render the scroll view, handing the content callback the live [`ScrollViewport`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.ScrollViewport) (scroll offset + visible size) so it can virtualize long content.
